name: UGC Dr. D. S. Kothari Postdoctoral Fellowship (DSKPDF)
funder: University Grants Commission (UGC), Government of India
amount: Rs 43,400-46,500/month (Rs 46,500 flat for outstanding candidates) + Rs 1 lakh/year contingency
other_rules: Below 35 years (relaxation 3 years OBC, 5 years SC/ST/women, 10 years PwD)
tenable only in science departments of Indian universities and UGC inter-university centres (not IITs, CSIR/DRDO/DAE labs or colleges)
postdoc should generally be at a different place from the PhD
reapply only 1 year after an unsuccessful result
notes: Annual renewal; maximum 3 years with no extension. Call dates not found (IndiaBioscience listing dates from 2018); check the official portal.
